faq.q: Can I read fuel level remotely on a Ford Maverick?
faq.a: Yes. A DIMO device reports Fuel Percentage (powertrainFuelSystemRelativeLevel) for the Maverick. Query it through the Telemetry API with a Vehicle JWT, and refuel segments also include the level signal at the start and end.

faq.q: How do I track a Ford Maverick with no connected services?
faq.a: Use a DIMO device, the DIMO LTE R1 in the Maverick record. Once the owner shares the vehicle with your Developer License, exchange your Developer JWT for a Vehicle JWT through the Token Exchange API and query the Telemetry API.

faq.q: How do I detect idling on a Ford Maverick?
faq.a: Query the Telemetry API segments resource with the idling mechanism, which requires a DIMO device. Idle segments are contiguous periods where engine RPM stays in the idle range, and you can set the upper bound with maxIdleRpm (default 1000).

faq.q: How do I detect harsh braking on a Ford Maverick?
faq.a: With a DIMO device, request the HarshBraking event in eventRequests on a segments query to get per-segment counts. For real-time alerts, create a webhook in the Vehicle Triggers API using the events service and the behavior.harshBraking metric name.

faq.q: How do I verify Ford Maverick mileage?
faq.a: A DIMO device reports the Odometer signal (powertrainTransmissionTravelledDistance) in km. To get verifiable proof, call the Attestation API odometer-statement endpoint with a Vehicle JWT, then retrieve the resulting credential through the Telemetry API.

intro: DIMO gives developers API access to vehicle-state data: diagnostics, fault codes, battery and fuel health, odometer, and maintenance signals. For the Ford Maverick, DIMO covers 2022 and newer model years through a DIMO device, the DIMO LTE R1, and that coverage has been tested. Vehicle owners consent to and control sharing, so builders get data with clear provenance. DIMO adds vehicle-state depth on top of GPS tracking; it doesn't replace it.
